title.zh: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
title.en: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT

current_state.zh: Blockchain investigator ZachXBT revealed he infiltrated a Chinese organized crime money-laundering network that washed over $1 billion in stolen crypto for North Korea's Lazarus Group, yielding tracing data and USDT freezes tied to the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.
